headline: An Agent Builds a More Exact Code Review
lede: Open Code Review divides the work deliberately: deterministic pipelines gather the right files and rules, while an LLM agent investigates context across the codebase. Its CLI turns that architecture into resumable reviews, precise findings, and workflows ready for local or enterprise use.

headline: A Living Guide to the Modern Web
lede: Modern Web Guidance gathers practical knowledge on HTML, CSS, JavaScript, accessibility, performance, and browser APIs into a searchable source for coding agents. Its curated guides help generated code favor native platform capabilities over inherited patterns and unnecessary layers.

headline: Codex Security Turns Findings Into Fixes
lede: Codex Security treats vulnerability analysis as a chain of evidence, from repository-wide scans and severity rules to validated patches and confirmed fixes. Its CLI, SDK, GitHub Actions, and export formats give security teams a repeatable path from alert to remediation.

headline: A Fluid Research Desk for Global Markets
lede: Daily Stock Analysis pulls market data, indicators, fundamentals, news, and sentiment into an LLM-assisted research flow. Dashboards, scheduled reports, portfolio tools, and backtesting connect raw feeds to watchlists, decisions, and recurring review.

headline: Sure Reclaims the Personal Finance Stack
lede: Sure rebuilds a full wealth-management workspace around self-hosting, open governance, and user-controlled financial data. Browser, desktop, mobile, API, and agent access sit on a Ruby, PostgreSQL, and Redis foundation that communities can extend rather than rent.

headline: A Visual Inbox for Human-Agent Collaboration
lede: Plannotator gives AI coding sessions a surface for plans, diffs, documents, questions, and decisions instead of leaving feedback buried in transcripts. Its browser interface, annotations, inbox, and broad tool integrations make review tangible, asynchronous, and precise.

headline: Uptime Kuma Keeps the Night Shift Visible
lede: Uptime Kuma watches websites, networks, certificates, containers, and internal services from a self-hosted dashboard. Fast checks, status pages, history charts, and a deep notification roster turn quiet background monitoring into a clear operational signal.

headline: Buzz Unifies Teams, Agents, and Git Activity
lede: Buzz gives human and machine participants one workspace for chat, documents, workflows, reviews, and repository events. Signed Nostr-compatible events, scoped agent identities, and YAML automation create a durable operational record across development and community work.

headline: Trading Skills Turns Market Judgment Into Process
lede: Claude Trading Skills assembles modular routines for market regimes, screening, sizing, journaling, and post-trade review. Its workflow gates and required artifacts keep the model in a decision-support role, making the experiment about repeatability and learning rather than automatic execution.

headline: Tailcat Opens a Smaller Path Through WireGuard
lede: Tailcat provides netcat-like connectivity over Tailscale’s encrypted data plane without accounts, elevated privileges, or system-routing changes. Its Go core handles NAT traversal, relay fallback, forwarding, SSH, and command access while keeping temporary connections narrowly scoped.
